question:
Who is the illustrator that illustrated the least amount of cards? List the format of play of the cards that he/she illustrated.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: format of the cards refers to format; illustrator refers to artist; the least amount of cards refers to MIN(artist)

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_004
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE T1.XCL_002 = (
    SELECT T2.XCL_002
    FROM cards AS T2
    WHERE T2.XCL_002 IS NOT NULL AND T2.XCL_002 != ''
    GROUP BY T2.XCL_002
    ORDER BY COUNT(T2.XCL_001) ASC, T2.XCL_002 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY T1.XCL_001 ASC
